commentary.text: 90+1' That's the end of the match.
88' Matus Bero (Bochum) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
88' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 58:42.
84' Dieter Hecking has decided to substitute Jakov Medic and he is replaced by Kacper Koscierski (Bochum).
83' A player from Bochum commits a rough challenge. Felix Zwayer blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
80' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Georgios Masouras leaves the pitch and Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) comes on.
77' We are about to witness a subsitution. Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) for Myron Boadu.
76' Substitution. Mats Pannewig makes way for Dani de Wit (Bochum).

71' St. Pauli control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
66' 0 - 2 GOAL! Myron Boadu (Bochum) runs onto a pass from Felix Passlack after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 0:2.
64' Alexander Blessin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) replacing Manolis Saliakas.
64' We are about to witness a substitution. Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) is replacing Danel Sinani.
63' One of the players from Bochum times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
61' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 9:5.
57' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) is being substituted because of an injury. Dieter Hecking sends Anthony Losilla on the pitch.
56' Looks like Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
55' Felix Zwayer interrupts the game. One of the players from Bochum won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
53' St. Pauli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
50' St. Pauli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
48' St. Pauli force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
48' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
46' Alexander Blessin makes a half-time substitution. Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) comes on in place of Oladapo Afolayan.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Felix Zwayer has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
42' Felix Zwayer couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Eric Smith (St. Pauli) and blew his whistle.
39' The linesman makes the right call and St. Pauli will have a corner.
38' The resulting set piece from St. Pauli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
34' St. Pauli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
33' Siebe Van Der Heyden is unable to continue after that nasty looking head injury. Alexander Blessin ushers on Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) to replace him.
32' Siebe Van Der Heyden (St. Pauli) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
30' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
29' Total attempts – 5:6.
26' Bochum force their opponents to concede a corner.
24' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
21' Felix Zwayer has a clear sight and sees a foul from Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli).

20' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) leaps high near the penalty spot and gets a header in from the free kick. It's on target, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save to deny the effort. It was a difficult header and it's always tough to put the ball inside the net from positions like that.
20' St. Pauli are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
18' The ball goes out of play and Bochum have been awarded a corner kick.
18' Mats Pannewig (Bochum) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Nikola Vasilj makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
14' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) tested Nikola Vasilj with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
10' 0 - 1 Myron Boadu (Bochum) displays great tekkers inside the box leading to a fantastic goal, leaving the goalkeeper stranded.
9' Bochum can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
9' Nikola Vasilj makes a world class save! Felix Passlack (Bochum) fires to the top right corner, but it's not enough to beat the excellent goalkeeper.
8' A bullet header by Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards over the crossbar.
7' St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
6' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from St. Pauli comes to nothing.
4' The St. Pauli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by St. Pauli, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
